title: C++ Developer, Market Data
description:
Brackwater Capital is a small proprietary trading firm. The market data team builds the feed handlers and the order book that every strategy reads.

You will write low latency C++ for Linux, work on lock-free queues between threads, and measure every change in nanoseconds.

We ask for
- 1 to 3 years of professional C++, or strong project work in C++.
- A good grip on multithreading and data structures.
- Comfort with TCP and UDP networking.

Nice to have: Python for tooling.

On-site in London. Graduates with strong projects are welcome to apply.
